narrative_purpose: This side-by-side shows bleaching as a broken partnership rather than death from outside: the same coral, colour-rich and algae-filled on one side, ghostly white over bare skeleton on the other, with only a small rise in warmth between them.
subject: A split comparison of one branching coral colony. On the left half: the coral is vivid and healthy, its tissue rich with colour and dense golden-brown algal cells, gently lit, small fish sheltering in its branches. On the right half: the identical coral has turned translucent and ghostly white, the bare pale limestone skeleton showing through, the golden cells gone, the water around it a warmer hazy tint and the sheltering fish absent. A subtle vertical seam divides the two states of the same colony.
scene: Shallow reef water, the left side cool and clear, the right side warmer and hazier, the same coral head spanning both.
camera: Straight-on medium view of a single coral colony, centred, split down the middle into two conditions.
light: Left: cool teal shafts and soft cyan glow with warm golden cells within the tissue. Right: a flat, warmer, slightly harsh haze with no living glow, the white skeleton coldly bright.
palette: Left uses ocean teal, cyan and a warm golden-amber tissue accent; right drains to pale stone-white and desaturated warm haze against indigo.
style: Hand-painted speculative-biology comparison plate, textured and observed, halves clearly contrasted without a hard graphic border.
detail_level: High detail on both coral states and the transition seam; surrounding water kept plain and hazy for callouts on each side.
composition: Healthy colony fills the left half with living colour, bleached colony fills the right half in ghostly white, open low-detail water flanking each for annotation.
consistency_notes: Both halves are the SAME branching coral colony, one alive and colourful with visible golden cells, one white and translucent over bare skeleton. Show warmth as a subtle change in water tone, not a drawn thermometer or number.
negative_prompt: no text, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no thermometer icon, no flat vector infographic, no photographic or CGI look, no cartoon style
